TEB.name: Teterboro Airport
TEB.fact: Teterboro, NJ · the busiest general-aviation airport in the New York area: private planes, business jets and the Hudson River sightseeing flights. In New York: about 30 min by car to Midtown.

LGA.name: LaGuardia Airport
LGA.fact: Queens · opened in 1939 on the shore of Flushing Bay. In New York: about 30 min by cab to Midtown, or the Q70 bus to the subway.

EWR.name: Newark Liberty International Airport
EWR.fact: Newark, NJ · opened in 1928, the New York area's first major airport. In New York: AirTrain and NJ Transit to Penn Station in about 30 min.
